fields.quoted_span: To calculate the dollar amount of the 1.6% annual rent increase, multiply the tenant's base rent by .016.
fields.note: D080 supports the 1.6% rate for 3/1/2026-2/28/2027, the calculation and example, and the 1.4% prior rate. It does not support the 1.7% prior rate, the exemptions (1979 Certificate of Occupancy, Costa-Hawkins, other agencies), the just-cause carve-out, or the capital improvement and labor rates.

fields.quoted_span: the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
fields.note: The 1.6% and 1.4% rates and their periods are in D080. The 1.7% rate for 2024-25 is not in this document, and the rate reset each March 1 is only implied.

fields.quoted_span: the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
fields.note: The 2026-03-01 effective date matches the start of the announced rate period.

fields.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
fields.note: The document announces the rate as effective from March 1, 2026, which is consistent with in force. It never says in force explicitly, and the announcement is dated January 14, 2026.
